PASS  P2 the flash rule is the one that carries it (filter, then the 420 ms pop), and under prefers-reduced-motion the pop is off
PASS  P3 the flash states change no geometry (no transform, size, position or margin on the field in any flash state) - only filter, opacity and stroke
PASS  P4 (mutant, landed) a drop-shadow on the field AT REST turns P1 red
